analyst_view.overall: Sparta Prague (22nd, 4 pts) host AZ (14th, 6 pts) at Letná, a rematch of last March's Conference League tie that AZ won 2-1 and 4-0. Sparta are in a bad spell: iSport reports a 1-3 home defeat to Liberec on Sunday with whistles and fan protests, coach Brian Priske is under heavy pressure though the club says he stays, and they are without Tobias Guddal (sent off against Bournemouth, already counted by the numbers) and, per iSport, Jan Hoever. AZ won 5-1 at Sparta Rotterdam on Saturday despite a long injury list (Kees Smit, Stije Resink, Lewis Schouten, Weslley Patati, Jizz Hornkamp), which their recent form already reflects. No referee is named yet. I lean slightly higher on goals and shots on target because Sparta's back line is thinner than the numbers know and confidence is low.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals and already take about 18% off Sparta's scoring and add 6% to AZ's for Guddal's ban. Hoever is also reported out, Sparta conceded three at home to Liberec and three to Bournemouth, and AZ just scored five; AZ's missing Smit is mostly in their recent form already, so I go only slightly higher, about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.6 corners, 5.8 for AZ. AZ like to work the ball wide and Sparta have conceded more corners lately (counted, +2%); nothing new points either way, so I stay at 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers expect 4.4 cards and already raise Sparta's by about 9% for a card-heavy run. A frustrated home side and an unhappy crowd can add fouls, but that mood is largely what the recent-form figure shows and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.4.

shots.text: The numbers expect 26.6 shots and already push AZ's up about 12% for their busy recent attack. AZ will have most of the ball; without Smit their midfield is less creative, which roughly cancels Sparta's weaker defence, so I stay at 26.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers expect 8.8 shots on target. With Guddal and Hoever missing and Sparta shaky at the back, AZ should get clean looks, so I go slightly higher, about 9.1.
